count_statement.text: Company says it holds 67 granted patents and 80+ pending U.S. and international patent applications (as of Dec 31, 2025). The FY2025 10-K breaks the 67 down as 45 US, 1 Canada, 2 UK, 12 EU, 1 Japan, 5 China (incl. Hong Kong) and 1 Korea, with issued patents expiring between 2027 and 2044.
count_statement.date: 2025-12-31 (stated in August 2026 investor presentation and FY2025 10-K)

patents.title: Non-linear optical materials containing high boiling point solvents, and methods of efficiently poling the same
patents.plain_english: Covers EO polymer formulations that keep a high-boiling-point solvent in the film so the chromophores can be aligned (poled) more efficiently.
patents.why_it_matters: Poling efficiency directly sets how much of the material's EO strength ends up in a real modulator.
patents.note: Co-assigned to Lightwave Logic, Inc. and Polariton Technologies Ltd. per Justia.

patents.title: Nonlinear optical chromophores having tetrahydrocarbazole donor groups, lyotropic compositions containing the same, and methods of poling such compositions
patents.plain_english: Continuation in the tetrahydrocarbazole-donor family: chromophores that self-organize like a liquid crystal in solvent, helping them line up with little or no electric field.
patents.why_it_matters: Extends protection on a potentially simpler, field-free poling route for manufacturing.

patents.title: Nonlinear optical chromophores having short-chain bridge structures, low optical loss materials containing the same, and methods for preparing the same
patents.plain_english: Chromophores with a short carbon bridge between donor and acceptor, which shifts and narrows their light absorption so films are more transparent with low optical loss and good thermal/photo stability.
patents.why_it_matters: Low optical loss and photostability are key requirements for commercial modulators.

patents.title: Electro-optic polymer devices having high performance claddings, and methods of preparing the same
patents.plain_english: Continuation of the high-performance cladding family: the layers surrounding the EO polymer core are engineered so the drive voltage reaches the polymer efficiently.
patents.why_it_matters: Claddings strongly affect poling efficiency and drive voltage in polymer modulators.
patents.note: Title confirmed via USPTO PDF link title and Google Patents family listing (app 18/430,886); grant date 2026-02-10 taken from a third-party research site (lwlg-research.pages.dev), not verified on USPTO.

patents.title: Nonlinear optical chromophores having a diamondoid group attached thereto, methods of preparing the same, and uses thereof
patents.plain_english: Another continuation in the diamondoid family: chromophores with bulky cage-like (adamantane-type) groups attached to keep molecules apart and improve robustness.
patents.why_it_matters: Broadens the diamondoid chromophore claim set that underpins the company's newer materials.

patents.title: Nonlinear optical chromophores, nonlinear optical materials containing the same, and uses thereof in optical devices
patents.plain_english: Continuation of the thiophene-bridge chromophore family, covering the molecules, materials made from them, and their use in optical devices such as EO films.
patents.why_it_matters: Protects core chromophore designs used in the company's polymer materials.

patents.title: Nonlinear optical chromophores having a diamondoid group attached thereto, methods of preparing the same, and uses thereof
patents.plain_english: Diamondoid-family continuation covering chromophores with attached diamondoid groups, how to make them, and their uses.
patents.why_it_matters: Part of a multi-patent wall around the diamondoid chromophore concept.

patents.title: Nonlinear optical chromophores having a diamondoid group attached thereto, methods of preparing the same, and uses thereof
patents.plain_english: Diamondoid-family continuation covering chromophores with diamondoid groups and related methods.
patents.why_it_matters: Adds further claim coverage around the diamondoid chromophore family.

patents.title: Nonlinear optical chromophores having tetrahydrocarbazole donor groups, lyotropic compositions containing the same, and methods of poling such compositions
patents.plain_english: Chromophore compositions that form liquid-crystal (lyotropic nematic) phases in polar solvents, letting the chromophore-polymer matrix become non-centrosymmetric without an applied electric field.
patents.why_it_matters: Field-free alignment could simplify and cheapen the poling step in production.

patents.title: Nonlinear optical chromophores, nonlinear optical materials containing the same, and uses thereof in optical devices
patents.plain_english: Thiophene-bridge chromophore family continuation covering molecules, materials and device uses.
patents.why_it_matters: Part of the chain protecting the company's primary chromophore designs.

patents.title: Nonlinear optical chromophores having tetrahydrocarbazole donor groups, lyotropic compositions containing the same, and methods of poling such compositions
patents.plain_english: Parent of the tetrahydrocarbazole-donor family: chromophores with a tetrahydrocarbazole donor that form ordered liquid-crystal phases, plus methods of poling them.
patents.why_it_matters: Starts a family aimed at easier, more efficient poling.

patents.title: Electro-optic polymer devices having high performance claddings, and methods of preparing the same
patents.plain_english: Continuation covering EO polymer devices built with specially engineered cladding layers around the active polymer.
patents.why_it_matters: Cladding design is central to low drive voltage and efficient poling.

patents.title: Nonlinear optical chromophores having a diamondoid group attached thereto, methods of preparing the same, and uses thereof
patents.plain_english: Original diamondoid patent: attaching bulky diamondoid groups to chromophores to reduce molecular clumping and improve material robustness.
patents.why_it_matters: Lead patent of the company's most-continued chemistry family.

patents.title: Nonlinear optical chromophores, nonlinear optical materials containing the same, and uses thereof in optical devices
patents.plain_english: Parent of the thiophene-bridge family: chromophores (donor-bridge-acceptor molecules) using thiophene bridges, and EO materials and devices that use them.
patents.why_it_matters: Anchors the company's modern chromophore portfolio; continuations run off it.
patents.note: Kind code B1 per Google Patents 'cited by' listing; filing date from a third-party research site.

patents.title: Electro-optic polymer devices having high performance claddings, and methods of preparing the same
patents.plain_english: Parent cladding patent: EO polymer devices whose cladding materials are chosen/engineered so the electric field and poling act efficiently on the polymer core.
patents.why_it_matters: Foundational to the cladding-stack family used in the company's modulators.

patents.title: Active region-less modulator and method
patents.plain_english: A polymer modulator in which the waveguide core is a sol-gel/SiO2 structure with EO polymer applied, avoiding a separately patterned active region.
patents.why_it_matters: Simplifies modulator structure for easier manufacturing.

patents.title: Hybrid EO polymer modulator with ALD sealant layer
patents.plain_english: A hybrid EO polymer modulator sealed with a conformal atomic-layer-deposition (ALD) layer to protect the polymer from oxygen and moisture.
patents.why_it_matters: Environmental sealing addresses polymer reliability, a historic weakness of EO polymers.

patents.title: Hybrid EO polymer modulator with silicon photonics
patents.plain_english: Combines an EO polymer modulator with silicon photonics, using a tapered waveguide embedded in a trench to couple light between silicon and polymer.
patents.why_it_matters: Enables polymer modulators to be added to standard silicon photonics foundry chips.

patents.title: TFP optical transition device and method
patents.plain_english: A thin-film-polymer device where light leaves a passive waveguide through a narrowed section coated with a single EO polymer layer and then returns, simplifying modulator fabrication.
patents.why_it_matters: Simplified light coupling into the polymer supports foundry-friendly designs.

patents.title: Active region-less polymer modulator integrated on a common PIC platform and method
patents.plain_english: Integrates an active-region-less polymer modulator onto a shared photonic integrated circuit (PIC) platform with other components.
patents.why_it_matters: Supports integration of polymer modulators with lasers and other PIC parts.

patents.title: Guide transition device and method
patents.plain_english: A structure for transitioning light between different waveguide types (e.g., semiconductor to polymer waveguide).
patents.why_it_matters: Efficient light transfer between materials is needed for hybrid polymer/silicon chips.

patents.title: Direct drive region-less polymer modulator methods of fabricating and materials therefor
patents.plain_english: Fabrication methods and materials for a region-less polymer modulator that can be driven directly by low-voltage electronics (continuation-in-part of US 10,591,755).
patents.why_it_matters: Direct CMOS drive removes the need for power-hungry driver amplifiers.

patents.title: Protection layers for polymer modulators/waveguides
patents.plain_english: Adds protective layers over polymer modulators and waveguides to shield them from the environment.
patents.why_it_matters: Protection layers improve reliability and lifetime of polymer devices.

patents.title: Hermetic capsule and method
patents.plain_english: A hermetically sealed capsule that encloses the polymer modulator chip at chip scale.
patents.why_it_matters: Chip-scale hermetic packaging lowers cost compared with traditional sealed packages.

patents.title: Fabrication process of polymer based photonic apparatus and the apparatus
patents.plain_english: A process for fabricating polymer-based photonic devices such as modulators, and the resulting device.
patents.why_it_matters: Covers manufacturing steps tied to modulator performance and reliability.

patents.title: Direct-drive polymer modulator methods of fabricating and materials therefor
patents.plain_english: Methods and materials for making polymer modulators that can be driven directly by CMOS ICs at low voltage.
patents.why_it_matters: Low-voltage direct drive is a key power-saving selling point.

patents.title: Hermetic capsule and method for a monolithic photonic integrated circuit
patents.plain_english: A hermetic capsule for sealing a monolithic photonic integrated circuit containing polymer devices.
patents.why_it_matters: Packaging protection for whole PICs, not just discrete modulators.

patents.title: Polymer modulator and laser integrated on a common platform and method
patents.plain_english: Puts a polymer modulator and a laser on the same chip platform.
patents.why_it_matters: Integration with lasers is needed for complete transmitter chips.

patents.title: Protection layers for polymer modulators/waveguides
patents.plain_english: Original protection-layer patent: barrier layers over polymer modulators/waveguides.
patents.why_it_matters: Addresses environmental stability of polymers.

patents.title: Guide transition device with digital grating deflectors and method
patents.plain_english: Uses digital grating deflectors to move light between waveguide layers/materials.
patents.why_it_matters: Another route for efficient coupling in hybrid photonic chips.

patents.title: Guide transition device and method
patents.plain_english: Original guide-transition patent for moving light between different waveguide types.
patents.why_it_matters: Basis of the guide-transition family.

patents.title: Multi-fiber/port hermetic capsule sealed by metallization and method
patents.plain_english: A hermetic capsule with multiple fiber/ports, sealed using metallization.
patents.why_it_matters: Low-cost hermetic sealing for multi-channel devices.

patents.title: Optoelectronic devices, methods of fabrication thereof and materials therefor
patents.plain_english: Patent acquired from Chromosol in 2022 covering optoelectronic devices, their fabrication and materials.
patents.why_it_matters: Acquired IP that broadens the materials/device portfolio.
patents.note: Number and title from LWLG FY2022 10-K (Chromosol acquisition); grant/filing dates not verified; a third-party site notes public records may still show the original (Queen Mary) assignee.

patents.title: Method for making an integrated circuit having optical data communication
patents.plain_english: Method of building an integrated circuit with an on-chip EO polymer optical data link.
patents.why_it_matters: Legacy acquired IP on electronic-photonic integration.
patents.note: Acquired lineage (GigOptix/BrPhotonics); grant date from third-party research site.

patents.title: Solderless electrical interconnections in a high speed photonic package
patents.plain_english: A removable, solder-free way to connect a high-speed photonic package to a circuit board using aligned contacts, a guide frame and a compressible pad.
patents.why_it_matters: Packaging IP acquired with the BrPhotonics portfolio.
patents.note: Justia shows assignee BRPHOTONICS Produtos Optoeletronicos Ltda.; listed under LWLG by GreyB; LWLG's 10-K says it bought 15 BrPhotonics patents in 2018.

patents.title: Fluorinated sol-gel low refractive index hybrid optical cladding and electro-optic devices made therefrom
patents.plain_english: A fluorinated sol-gel cladding material with low refractive index for EO polymer devices.
patents.why_it_matters: Cladding materials help confine light and apply voltage efficiently.
patents.note: Listed on LWLG's own patent portfolio page; grant date from third-party research site.

patents.title: Integrated circuit with optical data communication
patents.plain_english: An integrated circuit that includes an EO polymer-based optical data communication link.
patents.why_it_matters: Acquired IP on putting optical I/O directly on chips.
patents.note: Date/filing from Google Patents family listing of US7902322 (shown as publication date). Acquired lineage.

patents.title: Stabilized electro-optic materials and electro-optic devices made therefrom
patents.plain_english: Continuation-in-part covering EO materials stabilized by bulky substituents and devices made from them.
patents.why_it_matters: Stability is essential for commercial EO polymers.

patents.title: Integrated electro-optic device and method of making
patents.plain_english: A semiconductor chip whose doped regions drive electrodes that modulate light in a poled organic chromophore core above it.
patents.why_it_matters: Early electronic-photonic integration IP.
patents.note: Justia shows original assignee GigOptix, Inc.; listed under LWLG by GreyB (acquired lineage).

patents.title: Intrinsically low resistivity hybrid sol-gel polymer clads and electro-optic devices made therefrom
patents.plain_english: A hybrid sol-gel cladding doped with tin-based charge traps so it conducts slightly, improving poling and drive efficiency.
patents.why_it_matters: Lower-resistivity claddings let more voltage reach the EO core.
patents.note: Original assignee GigOptix; Google lists current assignee Lightwave Logic.

patents.title: Tricyclic spacer systems for nonlinear optical devices
patents.plain_english: Tricyclic spacer molecules that keep chromophores apart to prevent aggregation in EO polymers (continuation of US 7,894,695).
patents.why_it_matters: Original PSI-TEC/Goetz chemistry underlying the company's materials.
patents.note: Exact grant date not seen; year 2012 inferred from patent number range.

patents.title: Heterocyclical anti-aromatic chromophore architectures
patents.plain_english: Chromophores built around heterocyclic anti-aromatic cores with donor/acceptor groups, designed for strong and stable EO response.
patents.why_it_matters: Described as a foundational LWLG chromophore patent; Google estimates expiry 2029-03-08.

patents.title: Heterocyclical, substituted phenazinamine-type non-linear optic chromophore architectures
patents.plain_english: Fully heterocyclic, anti-aromatic phenazinamine-type chromophores aiming for strong EO response in compact, stable molecules.
patents.why_it_matters: Early PSI-TEC chemistry; reportedly expired Oct 2025.

patents.title: Nonlinear optical chromophores with stabilizing substituent and electro-optic devices
patents.plain_english: Chromophores carrying a substituent whose central atom bonds to three aryl groups, improving stability.
patents.why_it_matters: Acquired Lumera-lineage chemistry; status active-reinstated per Google (est. expiry 2028-11-13).

patents.title: Tricyclic spacer systems for nonlinear optical devices
patents.plain_english: Tricyclic compounds that separate chromophores to prevent aggregation and support stable polymer EO materials.
patents.why_it_matters: Original PSI-TEC/Goetz chemistry.

patents.title: Electro-optic chromophore having an edot structure, and related methods and apparatuses
patents.plain_english: Chromophores using an EDOT-type bridge plus related polymer matrices and EO devices.
patents.why_it_matters: Acquired legacy chromophore IP.
patents.note: Assignee not shown on uspto.report; listed under LWLG by GreyB.

patents.title: Electro-optic polymer devices with semiconducting oligomer clads
patents.plain_english: EO waveguide with a polymer core and a crosslinked aryl-based oligomer cladding that lets the electric field reach the active polymer.
patents.why_it_matters: Acquired cladding IP; reinstated, est. expiry 2028-06-08 per Google.
patents.note: Google legal events show 2018 assignment to Lightwave Logic, Inc.

patents.title: Method of biasing and operating electro-optic polymer optical modulators
patents.plain_english: Methods for biasing and operating EO polymer modulators.
patents.why_it_matters: Operational IP relevant to running polymer modulators stably.
patents.note: Grant date from third-party research site.

patents.title: Electro-optic polymer waveguide devices incorporating organically modified sol-gel clads
patents.plain_english: EO waveguides with a polymer core and an organically modified sol-gel buffer cladding of lower refractive index.
patents.why_it_matters: Acquired legacy IP; Google lists it expired (2023-12-16).
patents.note: Original assignee Lumera Corp; likely expired.

patents.title: Polymers having pendant nonlinear optical chromophores and electro-optic devices therefrom
patents.plain_english: Polymers with attached donor-bridge-acceptor chromophores using a 3,4-dioxythiophene bridge, and EO devices from them.
patents.why_it_matters: Acquired legacy IP; expired 2022-06-15 per Google.

patents.title: Highly stable and efficient nonlinear optical chromophores for electro-optic polymers
patents.plain_english: Chromophores with new acceptors, donors and bridges, plus polymer matrices and EO devices using them.
patents.why_it_matters: Acquired legacy IP; expired 2021-11-23 per Google.

patents.title: Design and synthesis of advanced NLO materials for electro-optic applications
patents.plain_english: Early patent on designing and synthesizing nonlinear optical (NLO) materials for EO applications.
patents.why_it_matters: Oldest item in aggregator lists; almost certainly expired.
patents.note: Number from GreyB list; title from USPTO PDF link title. Assignee and exact dates not verified; year inferred from number range.

pending_applications.note: Slot modulator coupled to coplanar transmission line with doped-silicon rails (inventors Lebby, Della Lucia). A third-party site reports a related slot-modulator patent granted 2026-01-27 but no number was found; status unverified.

notes: Built from Justia (assignee + inventor pages for Lebby, Pecinovsky, Ramann, Johnson, Zhiming Liu), Trea, GreyB, Minesoft (report dated 2026-11-06), Google Patents/USPTO individual pages, LWLG's patent-portfolio page and SEC 10-Ks. Google Patents assignee search and Justia assignee pagination were not reachable, so the list may miss a few grants. 52 US patents listed. Company's own count is 45 US grants as of 2025-12-31; the list has more because it includes legacy Lumera/GigOptix/BrPhotonics patents (bought in 2018) that have since expired (e.g. US 6,864,375; 7,019,453; 7,206,490; probably 6,716,995 and 7,919,619) and the Chromosol patent US 9,837,794. Four of the listed grants (12547041, 12565587, 12668743, 12716024) came in 2026, after the 10-K count date. Gaps: (1) A third-party site reports a slot modulator patent (coplanar transmission line; Lebby/Enami/Liu) granted 2026-01-27, but no number was found, so it is left out. (2) Exact grant dates were not seen for US 8,298,326 and 6,716,995 (years inferred from the number range) or US 9,837,794. Filing dates are null where none was seen. (3) The 12547041 grant date comes from a third-party site. (4) Several older acquired patents show original assignees (GigOptix, BrPhotonics, Lumera) on Justia; Google Patents lists Lightwave Logic as current assignee for most. (5) Foreign family members (EP, CN, JP, CA, AU, KR, WO) are not itemized; GreyB lists e.g. EP2646873B9, EP1805150B1, CN102304130B, CN103430090B, CA2818849C, CA2584792C, JP5737792B2, JP5241234B2, ES2604930T3, ES2599075T3, DE602005049851T2. (6) Pending list = published US applications not yet matched to a grant, mainly from Minesoft. Some may since have issued. US 2025/0208474 (ferroelectric nematic LC for hybrid slot modulators) is excluded because no assignee was shown. Aggregator counts differ: GreyB 78 docs/41 granted/29 families; Minesoft (10 yr) 52 grants, 48 families, 157 applications. US 12,187,945 (Polaris) and US 2024/0356517 (Murata) are NOT LWLG.
